From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, May 02, 2027 at 2:12 PM -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan & next steps from today's call

Hi Jordan

Thanks again for your time today - great conversation with you and Alex. Quick recap and the Mutual Action Plan (attached):

- Goal: 3-week evaluation to validate inference latency and cost for Acme's customer-facing feature.
- Scope: 2 endpoints (search, chat), dataset subset (~10k queries), perf and qualitative checks.
- Success criteria: 95th perc latency under 400ms for chat; acceptable cost per 1k tokens target.

Ask: Could you confirm owners and target dates in the MAP so we can lock resources on our side? Specifically:
- Technical owner (internal): who at Acme will lead the tests and be our day-to-day contact?
- Procurement owner: who will own the commercial steps and contract sign-off?
- Target kickoff date: does the week of May 17 look ok?

Attached: Acme_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx, acme-eval-checklist.pdf

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm owners/dates in the MAP (or reply with changes)
2) We schedule a 30-min tech kickoff with our Solutions Engineer (SE) to map the eval plan
3) We provision a dedicated eval tenant and share test credentials

Suggested windows for the kickoff: Tue 5/18 10-11am PT or Wed 5/19 9-10am PT - let me know what works.

If you'd prefer, I can set up a quick mutual action plan document in Google and invite both owners to update.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
